notes.title: N.E.R.O. has just received a new patch
notes.notes:
Hi N.E.R.O. players, we just released a new patch! Especially Arabic players will enjoy this one, but there are several fixes and changes. You can read the patchnotes here:

•	All occurrences of the Nero logo have been changed to a new logo.
•	Subtitles in videos and in game are now correctly displayed for Arabic.
•	A skip option has been added to several videos.
•	Removed duplicated audio lines occurring both in game and in the videos.
•	Added a field of view option.
•	Sensitivity system has been adjusted to allow for more accuracy when aiming the "Sphere of Light".

We hope you’ll enjoy N.E.R.O. even more after updating!

To celebrate the patch both N.E.R.O. and ENKI are on sale with an addtional discount in the Storm in a Teacup bundle! 

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/694/

notes.title: N.E.R.O.: Nothing Ever Remains Obscure Patch + PlayStation 4
notes.notes:
N.E.R.O. has just received a patch with some fixes and some technical features that were requested by the community. 
In addition to that we also have some great news for the all those console gamers out there: N.E.R.O.: Nothing Ever Remains Obscure is coming to PlayStation 4 on the 24th of June. The game will also be available at retail stores all over Europe.
Check out the patch notes below for a full list of the features and fixes. 

Patch Notes
Added Quality option to the video settings, user can use this to manage their RAM and VRAM use more closely
Added Anti aliasing option to the video settings
Added Lens Flare option to the video settings
Adjusted loading sequence to use less memory and be more efficient 
Added fading screen when applying visual settings in game 
Fixed faulty collision objects
Adjusted vibration pattern when using the controller 
Updated Credits
